message.content:
Wikipedia API requires User-Agent header. Let's send User-Agent using python script in `run_command`.
```python
script_content = """import urllib.request
import json

req = urllib.request.Request(
    'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&titles=Moon&format=json',
    headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'}
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))

pages = data['query']['pages']
page_id = list(pages.keys())[0]
content = pages[page_id]['revisions'][0]['*']

lines = [line for line in content.split('\\n') if 'perigee' in line.lower() or 'apogee' in line.lower()]
print('\\n'.join(lines[:20]))
"""
await write_file("./get_moon.py", script_content)
cmd_out = await run_command("python ./get_moon.py")
print(cmd_out)
```
